en: Well, you'd better hurry up and get changed.
Yamaura-san? Are you all right?

Well, to tell you the truth, I haven't been in a TV station
in a while.
Yeah. I'm kinda nervous.
It'll be all right, Yamaura-san.
Heh. Sorry. I should be the one saying that to you.
That's okay. Shall we go? The dressing room is right up here.
Okay. I'll go check it out for you first.
Sawamura.
It's me, T-Set's manager.
Nakai-san?
So, your president just dies and here you are, huh?

But I guess a tiny little agency like yours can't afford to
show some respect, can it?
If you'll excuse me.

By the way, are you sure your president's death was really a
suicide?

Park-san had a lot of enemies, after all. There's quite a
few in the industry that would've been glad to see her go.
Are you sure somebody didn't kill her and make it look like suicide?
I see we're aiming for the sympathy votes today.

Say, what if the killer turns out to be somebody from Dyna
Chair?
Please, stop!
Nakai-san, if I win against T-Set...
Will you promise to leave us alone and never speak to us again?
You're a funny girl, you know that?
Do you promise?
If you want me to promise, then you gotta put up somethin' on your end, too.
I know! If you lose, you have to switch to our agency. Deal?
You could be an opener for T-Set.

Be great to have two nice big sisters to look after you,
wouldn't you agree?
...It's a deal.
You better hold up your end when you lose!
Please excuse me.

Oh, do you mind if I pop into a convenience store before we
go?
Not at all. I'll wait right here.
Great. I'll be back in a second.
Voicemail?
This is Mai... from T-Set.
I wanted to tell you something before you left for Tokyo...
So I asked Yamaura-san for your cell phone number.

I heard a little bit about what happened. I had no idea all
that was going on...
And right in the middle of the Princess League finals, too!
...We'll be waiting for you to come back to Osaka, ya hear?
You'd better come back when you're done in Tokyo!
We ended up winning the Princess League by default...
But that's not a real win, is it?
Mai-san...
Good luck in Tokyo. And keep working hard.

Azusa and I are working twice as hard now too, so we'll be
ready next time we share the stage.

Oh, yeah. Remember that promise about coming over to our
agency if you lost?

Nakai-san wanted me to tell you he didn't mean it. He only
said that to light a fire under us.

Of course, he also said if you wanted to come over to Osaka
Talent, he'd be happy to have you.
...Azusa and I would be happy, too.
Take care, Haruka.

(Shin-Osaka Station, huh? She probably took a taxi. I'll
take one, too.)
(Haruka-chan... Damn it! Where could she be!?)
(Okay, first stop, Dyna Chair!)

(So he wants to talk about Park-san's suicide, does he? I
don't know who this guy is, but I guess he's waiting for me
over at Sky Finance.)
Thank you, Akiyama-san! That was delicious!
Good, I'm glad. And I'm glad we got to talk about stuff, too.

Anyway, you have the Princess League to think about. We'd
better call it a day.
I hope all that crab doesn't slow you down.
Hehe. I think I'll be all right.

All right. If I find out anything about Katsuya, I'll let
you know.
Okay. Good night!

It's Yamaura. Soten TV just sent me tomorrow's Princess
League schedule.
You're on, Haruka. Are ya ready?

You haven't forgotten that promise, have you? About going
over to Osaka Talent if you lose...?
I haven't.
How're ya feelin' about that?
I won't lose to Osaka Talent. Don't worry.

Okay. I won't. All right, come to the office first thing in
the mornin'.
Christina and I will go over your lessons one last time with you.

And remember. Those T-Set girls might be a mean little pair
of brats...

But their dancin' and singin' these past few years has put
them at the top.

It's gonna take a lot more than just wishin' to win. Don't
underestimate 'em.
I won't.
Okay. Good night, then.

I get the feeling we'll end up having to talk to this
Katsuya of Osaka Talent.
Do you want to go now?
No. I think I'll go tomorrow.

A surprise attack while he's in his office is probably the
best way to go.

I'm sure they know who you are over there, so I'd better go
alone. That all right with you?
Yes, that's fine.
Good. Okay, that's it for the investigation for today.

But, you know, I'm feeling kind of hungry. What do you say?
Want to go get something to eat and clear our heads?

It's been nothing but "dark this" and "grim that" since we
met, so how about it? My treat.
Hehe, I guess you have a point. All right, then. I'd love to, Akiyama-san.

Okay, what are you in the mood for? Osaka's famous for its
takoyaki, you know.

Then again, that's not really a proper dinner. How about
okonomiyaki?

But wait a minute. Now that I think about it, you live here
in Osaka.
You're probably sick of all that stuff.
Really, Akiyama-san, anything is fine with me...

Let's see. What else is Osaka famous for? Fugu? Nah. Grilled
meat? Oh! There's always crab...

But you're a high school kid. I doubt you have the same
taste as an old guy like me.
Let's see. What else is there...?
Well, um...
I'd, um... I'd like to try crab.
Crab? Wait, "try" it?
I've never had it before in my life. Not real crab anyway...

That does it, then! We're going to Kani Douraku! I'm buying
you as much crab as you can eat!
(Crest Bar. This is it.)
Now we can finally have a civilized discussion.
Son of a bitch!
I imagine you've heard of Mirei Park, of Dyna Chair?

Nobody's coming to save you in a place like this. We've got
plenty of time.
If you don't start talking, I'm not going to play nice anymore.
You forged Park-san's suicide note, didn't you?

All I did was introduce a forger to a guy who said he wanted
a suicide note forged.
I never met the guy in person. We only talked on the phone.
So who is this forger? Take me to him.
Fine. I'll show ya the way.
(The parking lot in Shofukucho. This must be the place.)
So it's a trap, is it?

I gave you my business card, didn't I? I run Sky Finance.
I'm a moneylender.
I'm just looking for a forger.

You said you wanted a suicide note forged. Who or what are
you tryin' to sniff out?

I'm afraid I don't know what you mean. Or are you telling me
you got a similar request lately?

You know, I think we'd get a lot further if you'd quit bein'
a wiseass.
Huh. That's funny. I was just thinking the same thing about you.
Boys, I want you to make this guy bleed.
Look, pal, it's been a long day, and I'm kind of worked up.
So don't mind me if I let loose a little. Don't say I didn't warn you!
This Akiyama-san?
And who might this be?
You just talked to me at the bar.
Ah, you're that chummy bartender, right?
So you're the forger?
No, but there's somebody I'd like ya to meet.
Come to the parking lot in Shofukucho. Now.
And if I'm busy?
Then, don't come.
(The parking lot in Shofukucho, huh? Guess I don't really have a choice.)

(I get the feeling I'm on the right track. Just have to wait
and see.)

So this is the bar the Kamurocho forger told me about, is
it?
Akiyama-san. Sorry to keep you waiting.
Sorry about all this, especially right after your Princess thing.
It's all right. I'm fine.
Okay. Shall we head in?
Ready to go in now?
I'm sorry. Could you give me just one minute?
Sure. I'll be right here.
All right, in we go.

All right. I'm goin' back to the office. You must be tired.
Why don't you take a break? Maybe go home first, before
comin' back?
Haruka-chan? This is Akiyama. Are you free right now?
Oh, Akiyama-san. I just finished taping.

You did? You must be exhausted, then. Sorry, but I was
hoping we could get together and talk.
I'd like your voice coach to be there, too.
She should be at Dyna Chair right now.

Okay, let's all meet there, then. I'll be waiting for you at
the entrance.
All right. Is this about the forger, by the way?

Sorry if I got your hopes up, but, no. This is something
else. Anyway, see you soon.
Okay. See you.
Hello? Haruka-chan!? It's Akiyama!
This is Yamaura.
Yamaura-san? Where's Haruka-chan!?
Some guys... They looked like yakuza... They took her!
They forced their way into the office and grabbed her.
Are you and Christina all right?
Yes, we're fine. What do we do!?
Did you call the police?

They said they'd kill her if we reported it. I don't know
what to do...
So this is what he used on Ogita, huh?
I didn't think you'd try to come find me.
About time you showed yourself, Kanai.

I had you checked out, you know. A Kamurocho moneylender?
What the hell do you want with me?
I want to kick your ass.
Think of it as a special greeting from Park-san.
Oh, that's right. There was somethin' I wanted to ask ya.
Do you know where the letter from Park's ex is?
Nope. And even if I did, I certainly wouldn't tell you.
I see. Then I don't need you anymore.

Akiyama-han, if you ain't gonna tell me where the letter is,
then I'll just hafta ask the girl.
Haruka Sawamura. Park sure thought a lot of that kid, didn't she?
What...!?
Heheh. My boys oughta be pickin' her up right now.
I plan on havin' a nice, long chat with her.
Kanai, stop! Leave her out of this!
Dammit! Out of my way!

I'm the one who killed Park. That bitch screwed me over on
some work-related shit.
So it was about money?

Nah, that ain't it. Dunno 'bout you, but I couldn't stand
her.
Always demandin' top-level work for shit pay.

And she tricked me into signin' a contract she could break
without payin' a penalty.

That's nothing new. In show business, results can't be
defined by numbers.

It's hard to clarify how well you did your job in your line
of work.
Hmph. The bitch said the same thing.

So that's why you killed her? For revenge? That's why you
hurt Horie-chan?

Nah. You got it all wrong. I was asked to do a certain job
for someone.
A job?

Ya see, I owe the loan sharks here at Ousaka Enterprises a
big hunk of money.

I didn't have enough to pay 'em back since Park broke my
contract. So I asked 'em to wait, but they gave me a job instead.

Said if I got a certain somethin' off of Park, they'd
forgive my debt.
What did they want?
Some letter she got from her ex-husband.
A letter? What would anybody want with that?
They were tryin' to track down this ex of hers, apparently.
They thought the letter would help find him.
So we broke into Dyna Chair to look for it.
Me and Kanai, that big yakuza you were scrappin' with.

But we couldn't find it. So we decided to wait till Park
came back to the agency.

When she showed up, I grabbed her and tried to get her to
tell me where that letter was.

But she kept quiet. She tried to make a run for it, but if
she'd gotten away, it'd have been all over for me.

So I chased her... Next thing I knew, I was smashin' her
head against the floor in the hallway.
It was then she stopped movin'.
Bastard! What did you do!?

Makin' it look like a suicide, that was all Kanai. Seemed
like that kind of thing was pretty old hat to him.

If it looked like a murder, the police woulda confiscated
everything.

But a suicide would buy us time to keep lookin' and figure
out where her ex was.
So Kanai worked his magic.
Why try to kill Horie-chan?
That was Kanai.

He tried to get the location of the letter out of Horie, but
Horie kept sayin' he didn't know.
So, after a little tussle, Kanai threw him off the roof.
Who exactly is this ex-husband of Park's?
Couldn't tell you...

There. That's all I know... You gotta help me. I'm a victim
here, too!

I don't wanna die! I'll confess. I'll tell the police
everything!
Just, please, get me outta here... Please!
How can Park-san rest in peace with you claiming to be a victim, too?
Please! Please help me! I don't wanna die!

I'm going to be making a lot of noise in the next few
minutes. You'd better use it as your chance to run.
What? What are ya gonna do?

I originally came here just to talk with Kanai, but after
all you've told me, I'm gonna have to knock his teeth in.

I dunno... You might think you're tough, but that Kanai's a
tank.
You better get outta here while you still can!
Not before I've taken care of business.
Is Kanai inside?
I'm going in.

Heh. Listen to this, boys! Guess Tokyo's got some pretty
funny comedians, too!
Look, I'm really not in the mood right now.
If you're trying to pick a fight, you'd better make sure you mean it.
Hah! This guy's a real barrel of laughs!
Can't you read? The sign said, "Keep Out."
I'm looking for your executive director.
